INSERT INTO builds (
              finished,
              timestamp,
              jobset_id,
              job,
              nixname,
              drvpath,
              storedir,
              system,
              maxsilent,
              timeout,
              ischannel,
              iscurrent,
              priority,
              globalpriority,
              keep
            ) VALUES (
              0,
              EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::INT4,
              $1,
              'debug',
              'debug',
              $2,
              $3,
              $4,
              7200,
              36000,
              0,
              0,
              100,
              0,
            0);
